Mexican Drug Lord 'El Mayo' Sentenced to Life in Prison

Ismael 'El Mayo' Zambada, a co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, was arrested at a US airport on July 24, 2024, and sentenced to life in prison. He had admitted to sending vast amounts of drugs to the US. The sentencing marks a significant blow to Mexico's narco old guard.
